inclusion_criteria.text: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer (mBC)
Disease progression under trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Willing and able to undergo a baseline tumor biopsy
Willing and able to provide blood collection at baseline and at pre‑specified time points
Willing and able to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT imaging
Willing and able to undergo baseline 89Zr‑trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2‑PET/CT) imaging
ECOG performance status ≤ 1

Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2‑positive breast carcinoma as per the updated ASCO‑CAP guidelines according to local testing; HER2 status may be determined in the primary tumour or, when not available, in a metastatic lesion
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumours are allowed if all tested HER2‑positive according to local testing
Prior treatment with taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting) and T‑DXd (metastatic setting)
Must have received T‑DXd as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and presented disease progression on this drug
Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible
Provided that T‑DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient presented disease progression on this drug
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months
At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required
Each target lesion must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm
Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean
Anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm

Metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≤ 1.5 x SUVmean + 2 standard deviations (SD) of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical volume of interest (VOI) in normal liver parenchyma
In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion should have a SUVmax ≤ 2 x SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta
Lesions must not have been pre‑treated with irradiation
Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) ≥ 1000/µL or ≥ 1 × 10⁹/L
Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL or ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L
Haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN)
Estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 ml/min as calculated using the method standard for the institution
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless the patient has documented Gilbert syndrome
Aspartate and Alanine Aminotransferase (AST and ALT) ≤ 2.5 × ULN
Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50% on echocardiography or multiple‑gated acquisition scanning
No history of a LVEF < 40%
No symptomatic heart failure
No recent myocardial infarction
Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) for translational research activities
Willingness to provide blood samples (mandatory) for translational research activities
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations
Signed Informed Consent form (ICF) obtained prior to any study‑related procedure
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (applicable to France only)

exclusion_criteria.text: Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for the treatment of metastatic breast cancer
For subjects exposed to T‑DM1 for the treatment of early breast cancer, must not have relapsed while on or within 12 months of finishing treatment with T‑DM1
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis
Brain metastasis symptomatic
Brain metastasis requiring therapy to control symptoms
History of interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis (grade 3 or 4) during prior treatment with T‑DXd
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to left‑ventricular dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving pre‑operative therapy
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure > 100 mmHg)
Inadequately controlled angina, serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by adequate medication, severe conduction abnormality, or clinically significant valvular disease
Screening LVEF < 50% by either echocardiography or MUGA
History of NCI CTCAE (Version 4.0) Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure (CHF) or New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class ≥ II
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40% or symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment (e.g., during pre‑operative therapy)
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to investigational product or any component in its formulations, including known severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1
If more than 7 rapid progressors (progressive disease within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy) have already been enrolled, further subjects with progression within the first 6 months are excluded
Progression within the first 6 months of T-DXd therapy after the first 7 rapid progressors have been included
Any known liver disease
Known carrier of hepatitis B virus
Known carrier of hepatitis C virus
Autoimmune hepatic disorders
Sclerosing cholangitis
Concurrent serious uncontrolled infections
Known infection with HIV
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years, except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated
Pregnant women
Lactating women
Intending to become pregnant during the study
Positive serum pregnancy test within 15 days prior to enrolment (for subjects of childbearing potential)

Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the course of the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use condom during the course of this study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1
Significant medical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study
Significant neuro‑psychiatric condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study
Significant surgical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that may interfere with completion of the study
Vulnerable persons according to article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code (adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection)
Adults unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code
